<!-- This is the low-ceremony one. Nothing below is required; answer whatever
     you have an opinion about and delete the rest. There is no wrong way to
     fill this in, and "I bounced off it" is one of the more useful things you
     can send. -->

## Did you leave it open?

<!-- The one question that matters most. If it earned a spot on your monitor,
     which panels did the earning? If it didn't, what closed it? -->

## Where did you get stuck, if anywhere?

<!-- The download, the first launch, a panel that wanted a credential you
     didn't want to create, something that looked broken but wasn't. -->

## What were you hoping to see at a glance that isn't there?

<!-- A panel, a vendor, a number. Rough is fine — "I want to know if X is
     down" is a complete thought. -->

## Anything else

<!-- Including "this is the wrong shape for my stack, and here's my stack". -->

---

Two things worth knowing, so nothing here is a surprise:

- Deliberately **not** in scope: alerting, history and retention, and anything
  requiring a server. This is a window you leave open, not a monitoring product.
- Found something actually broken? The
  [bug report](https://github.com/Sassy-Dog/solador/issues/new?template=bug_report.md)
  template asks the couple of questions that make it fixable — but if you'd
  rather just say what happened here, that's fine too.
